title: The knee-treatment travel enquiry question-list song short

reference.observed_workflow: audio-first song ad with 5–7 second A-roll/B-roll slices; original production only

format.channel: organic social only pending policy review

audio_master.brief: Original 94 BPM, warm percussive pop/indie mnemonic, confident but calm, natural adult English vocal, no celebrity or artist imitation. The vocal should be intelligible first and musical second.
audio_master.structure: 2-bar intro/hook · four 7-second lyric slices · 2-bar resolved CTA
production_order: Generate and rights-check one master audio file
Generate A-roll with its corresponding slice as lip-sync source
Generate B-roll to the same beat grid
Create captions from final audio alignment

visual_system.a_roll: same fictional facilitator educator, warm 3D world, direct-camera only on hook/coordination/CTA
visual_system.b_roll: abstract checklists, sealed folder, paper tiles, travel/communication tokens; no patient or hospital identification
visual_system.captions: 56px Inter Black, cream with navy outline, word pop on the downbeat, lower-middle safe zone, two lines max.
visual_system.cuts: Cut on music-bar boundaries; reserve the 28–35s turn for a longer visual hold.

guardrails: Create an original melody, rhythm, vocal and art direction. Do not imitate, sample, interpolate, or reference a named artist, song, creator, or the linked example’s audio/video.
Use only music/vocal audio with documented commercial-use rights. Retain licence, prompt, generation ID, audio fingerprint and project owner in the production ledger.
This format is organic-draft only until paid-health-ad policy review. No outcomes, price claims, clinical advice, fear hooks, patient imagery, hospital rankings or unconsented data.
Audio is the source of truth. Every A-roll scene must be generated with, or lip-synced against, its exact approved 7-second audio slice. Never pad, loop, or overlay unmatched speech.
